title: LittlePrince_MEG_French_Listen_Pallier2025
description: Magnetoencephalography (MEG) recordings from 58 healthy native French-speaking adults who listened to the French audiobook of Le Petit Prince, split into 9 runs of about 11 minutes each. The dataset includes simultaneous EOG and ECG, plus T1-weighted anatomical MRI for source reconstruction. It supports research on naturalistic speech comprehension and decoding of individual words from non-invasive brain recordings.
methods_description: MEG was recorded in a magnetically shielded room with an Elekta Neuromag TRIUX system (102 magnetometers, 204 planar gradiometers) at 1000 Hz, with an online 0.1-330 Hz band-pass. Bipolar EOG and ECG were recorded simultaneously. Auditory stimuli were delivered through MEG-compatible earphones across 9 runs. T1-weighted MPRAGE anatomical scans were acquired on a 3T Siemens Prisma scanner.

funding_references.funder_name: French National Research Agency (Agence Nationale de la Recherche)
